name: Tether
author: Erin Carter
description: A handful of mooring lights ride at anchor on black water, each a small glowing buoy with a dim reflection streak, held by one thin tether to its own fixed anchor. An unseen current veers slowly, so every light weathervanes around its anchor in lazy arcs — tethers straightening taut and bright at the moment of turning, then bowing slack again.

params.label: Veer speed
params.effect: Rate at which the current's heading wanders, and so how briskly the moored lights swing through their arcs.

params.label: Tether length
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of each mooring line, setting the radius of the arc its light swings through.

params.label: Buoy glow
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of each buoy's glow core and its reflection streak's width.
